command.name: hand-to-human
command.provenance: hand-to-human --help ('Hand a bead to the operator (human + attention, escalated removed, one update)'), packages/hand-to-human show_help at this commit (the host's installed copy predates --also-add, --note and --if-*)

provenance.source: hand-to-human --help, first line: "hand-to-human: Hand a bead to the operator (human + attention, escalated removed, one update)"; packages/hand-to-human/hand-to-human/hand-to-human.sh show_help

stdin.source: hand-to-human --help: no input is read from stdin; every input is an argument (usage line "hand-to-human ID [--backend NAME | --bd-dir DIR] [--also-remove LABEL]... [--actor ID]")

stdout.source: hand-to-human --help, Output: "the bead id on stdout; what the read-back verified on stderr" (one id, metadata)

unknownFlag.source: hand-to-human --help lists exactly: --backend, --bd-dir, --also-remove, --actor, -h/--help, -v/--version; any other flag is unmodeled and insufficient (usage error, exit 2)

citation.source: hand-to-human --help: "--actor ID  Actor for the audit trail (bd only; default: bd's own resolution from BEADS_ACTOR)." an inert identity string

hand-to-human --help (packages/hand-to-human/hand-to-human/hand-to-human.sh show_help): "--also-add L  Add one more label in the same call (repeatable) ... `escalated`, `human` and `attention` are refused." a label name, inert
hand-to-human --help: "--also-remove L  Remove one more label in the same call (repeatable), for example needs-split-review." a label name, inert
hand-to-human --help: "--backend NAME  Reach the tracker through `pg-connector issue update --backend NAME` instead of bd" a backend name, inert
hand-to-human --help: "--bd-dir DIR  Tracker root to run bd against (bd -C DIR). Default: the caller's current directory." a directory the tool reads through bd -C
hand-to-human --help: "--if-assignee V  Claim guard (bd only): write only when the bead's assignee is V now (an empty V means unassigned)" a compare value, inert
hand-to-human --help: "--if-status V  Claim guard (bd only): write only when the bead's status is V now (for example open). Needs --note." a compare value, inert
hand-to-human --help: "--note TEXT  Append TEXT to the bead's notes in the same call (bd only: `bd update --append-notes`)." free text handed to bd as data, inert
hand-to-human --help, Usage: "hand-to-human ID [--backend NAME | --bd-dir DIR] ...": ID is the one positional, a bead id (inert)

hand-to-human --help: "Adds the labels `human` and `attention` to bead ID and removes `escalated`, all in ONE update call" followed by a read-back (`bd show`): a beads tracker write, the same effect as handoff-create's bd create
